package teacherdialog

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type PedagogyPlanner interface {
	Plan(
		teacher domain.PersonalTeacher,
		request domain.DialogTeacherRequest,
		student domain.StudentContext,
		dialog domain.DialogRequestContext,
		prior []domain.TeacherDecision,
	) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error)
}

// PedagogyMethodInput is the stable method boundary. New methodologies receive
// the same validated context and cannot bypass the final plan invariants.
type PedagogyMethodInput struct {
	Teacher          domain.PersonalTeacher
	Request          domain.DialogTeacherRequest
	Student          domain.StudentContext
	Dialog           domain.DialogRequestContext
	Prior            []domain.TeacherDecision
	SelectedFallback bool
}

// PedagogyMethod is a replaceable deterministic teaching method. A method is
// selected by PersonalTeacher.PedagogyProfile and registered at composition.
type PedagogyMethod interface {
	Code() string
	Version() string
	Plan(input PedagogyMethodInput) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error)
}

// PedagogyRegistry routes to registered methods without hard-coding method
// switches into TeacherOrchestrator. Replacing a method is a composition change;
// adding one requires only another implementation and registration.
type PedagogyRegistry struct {
	methods  map[string]PedagogyMethod
	fallback string
}

func NewPedagogyRegistry(fallback string, methods ...PedagogyMethod) (PedagogyRegistry, error) {
	fallback = normalizeMethodIdentity(fallback)
	registry := PedagogyRegistry{methods: make(map[string]PedagogyMethod, len(methods)), fallback: fallback}
	for _, method := range methods {
		if method == nil {
			return PedagogyRegistry{}, errors.New("pedagogy method is required")
		}
		code := normalizeMethodIdentity(method.Code())
		version := normalizeMethodIdentity(method.Version())
		if code == "" || len(code) > 64 || version == "" || len(version) > 64 {
			return PedagogyRegistry{}, errors.New("invalid pedagogy method identity")
		}
		if _, exists := registry.methods[code]; exists {
			return PedagogyRegistry{}, fmt.Errorf("duplicate pedagogy method %s", code)
		}
		registry.methods[code] = method
	}
	if _, exists := registry.methods[fallback]; !exists {
		return PedagogyRegistry{}, errors.New("fallback pedagogy method is not registered")
	}
	return registry, nil
}

func (registry PedagogyRegistry) Plan(
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher,
	request domain.DialogTeacherRequest,
	student domain.StudentContext,
	dialog domain.DialogRequestContext,
	prior []domain.TeacherDecision,
) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error) {
	normalizedRequest, err := validatePedagogyContext(teacher, request, student, dialog, prior)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, err
	}
	configured := normalizeMethodIdentity(teacher.PedagogyProfile)
	method, found := registry.methods[configured]
	if !found {
		method = registry.methods[registry.fallback]
	}
	if method == nil {
		return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, errors.New("pedagogy registry is not configured")
	}
	plan, err := method.Plan(PedagogyMethodInput{
		Teacher: teacher, Request: normalizedRequest, Student: student, Dialog: dialog,
		Prior: append([]domain.TeacherDecision(nil), prior...), SelectedFallback: !found,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, err
	}
	plan, err = domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(plan)
	if err != nil || plan.MethodCode != normalizeMethodIdentity(method.Code()) ||
		plan.MethodVersion != normalizeMethodIdentity(method.Version()) {
		return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	return plan, nil
}

// ProgressiveHintMethod is the first replaceable deterministic method. It owns
// the help ceiling; the model may formulate but cannot choose or raise it.
type ProgressiveHintMethod struct{}

func (ProgressiveHintMethod) Code() string    { return domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode }
func (ProgressiveHintMethod) Version() string { return domain.ProgressiveHintMethodVersion }

func (method ProgressiveHintMethod) Plan(input PedagogyMethodInput) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error) {
	if input.Request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextGeneral {
		return domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
			PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
			MethodCode:    method.Code(), MethodVersion: method.Version(),
			TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModeLesson, Strategy: "differentiated_instruction",
			Stage: domain.AMCDOrient, Action: domain.TeacherActionRespond, HintLevel: 0,
			Guidance: domain.TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation, AllowCompleteSolution: false,
			ReasonCode:    "bounded_learner_overview",
			ReasonSummary: "Answer the general teacher request using the bounded Student-owned learner overview and recent mastery projection.",
		})
	}
	if input.Request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextLesson {
		source := input.Dialog.Messages[len(input.Dialog.Messages)-1].LessonContext
		if source == nil {
			return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		reasonCode := "verified_lesson_selection"
		reasonSummary := "Explain only the selected fragment verified against the exact current Course revision."
		if source.Mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
			reasonCode = "verified_lesson_overview"
			reasonSummary = "Answer using only the bounded lesson overview verified against the exact current Course revision."
		}
		if source.Schema == domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
			reasonSummary = "Explain only the selected fragment verified against the exact frozen Student assignment."
			if source.Mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
				reasonSummary = "Answer using only the bounded overview verified against the exact frozen Student assignment."
			}
		}
		return domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
			PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
			MethodCode:    method.Code(), MethodVersion: method.Version(),
			TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModeLesson, Strategy: "conceptual_explanation",
			Stage: domain.AMCDRealize, Action: domain.TeacherActionRespond, HintLevel: 0,
			Guidance: domain.TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation, AllowCompleteSolution: false,
			ReasonCode: reasonCode, ReasonSummary: reasonSummary,
		})
	}
	maximumLevel := 0
	priorHints := 0
	for _, decision := range input.Prior {
		if decision.Action != domain.TeacherActionGiveHint {
			continue
		}
		priorHints++
		if *decision.HintLevel > maximumLevel {
			maximumLevel = *decision.HintLevel
		}
	}
	level := maximumLevel + 1
	limit := 7
	if input.Student.PracticeTask != nil {
		limit = input.Student.PracticeTask.AssistancePolicy.MaxHintLevel
	}
	if limit == 0 {
		action := domain.TeacherActionAskQuestion
		guidance := domain.TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion
		strategy := "policy_bounded_question"
		if input.Student.PracticeTask.AssistancePolicy.Teacher.MayExplain {
			action = domain.TeacherActionRespond
			guidance = domain.TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation
			strategy = "policy_bounded_explanation"
		}
		return domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
			PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
			MethodCode:    method.Code(), MethodVersion: method.Version(), TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModePractice,
			Strategy: strategy, Stage: domain.AMCDOrient, Action: action, HintLevel: 0,
			Guidance: guidance, AllowCompleteSolution: false,
			ReasonCode:    "practice_assistance_policy",
			ReasonSummary: "The immutable task assistance policy forbids progressive hints; stay within its explanation/question boundary.",
		})
	}
	if level > limit {
		level = limit
	}
	guidance, strategy, stage := guidanceForLevel(level)
	reasonCode := "progressive_hint"
	if input.Student.PracticeTask != nil {
		reasonCode = "practice_policy_bounded_hint"
	}
	if input.SelectedFallback || strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Teacher.HintPolicy)) != domain.DefaultHintPolicy {
		reasonCode = "safe_progressive_fallback"
	}
	mode := domain.TeachingModePractice
	if input.Request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextProject {
		mode = domain.TeachingModeProject
	}
	return domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
		PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
		MethodCode:    method.Code(), MethodVersion: method.Version(),
		TeachingMode: mode, Strategy: strategy, Stage: stage,
		Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: level, Guidance: guidance,
		AllowCompleteSolution: false, ReasonCode: reasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: fmt.Sprintf(
			"Selected bounded hint level %d after %d prior hint decisions for this learning action.",
			level, priorHints,
		),
	})
}

func validatePedagogyContext(
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher,
	request domain.DialogTeacherRequest,
	student domain.StudentContext,
	dialog domain.DialogRequestContext,
	prior []domain.TeacherDecision,
) (domain.DialogTeacherRequest, error) {
	normalizedRequest, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	if err != nil || !domain.SupportsTeacherDialogRuntime(request.ContextType) {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	if _, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(dialog); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if !sameTeacherContext(teacher, normalizedRequest, student, dialog) {
		return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	for _, decision := range prior {
		if !requiresActionContext(normalizedRequest.ContextType) {
			return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
		if decision.StudentID != normalizedRequest.StudentID ||
			decision.LearningActionID != normalizedRequest.LearningActionID {
			return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
		if decision.Action == domain.TeacherActionGiveHint &&
			(decision.HintLevel == nil || *decision.HintLevel < 1 || *decision.HintLevel > 7) {
			return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	}
	return normalizedRequest, nil
}

func requiresActionContext(contextType domain.LearningContextType) bool {
	return contextType == domain.LearningContextLessonTask ||
		contextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || contextType == domain.LearningContextProject
}

func sameTeacherContext(
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher,
	request domain.DialogTeacherRequest,
	student domain.StudentContext,
	dialog domain.DialogRequestContext,
) bool {
	_, teacherIDErr := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(teacher.ID))
	_, studentIDErr := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(teacher.StudentID))
	return teacherIDErr == nil && studentIDErr == nil && teacher.ID == request.PersonalTeacherID &&
		teacher.StudentID == request.StudentID && strings.TrimSpace(teacher.Language) != "" &&
		student.StudentID == request.StudentID && student.LearningActionID == request.LearningActionID &&
		student.ContextType == request.ContextType && student.ContextID == request.ContextID &&
		dialog.DialogID == request.DialogID && dialog.StudentID == request.StudentID &&
		dialog.PersonalTeacherID == request.PersonalTeacherID && dialog.ContextType == request.ContextType &&
		dialog.ContextID == request.ContextID && dialog.SourceMessageID == request.SourceMessageID &&
		dialog.LearningActionID == request.LearningActionID
}

func guidanceForLevel(level int) (domain.TeacherGuidance, string, domain.PedagogyStage) {
	switch level {
	case 1:
		return domain.TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion, "socratic", domain.AMCDOrient
	case 2:
		return domain.TeacherGuidanceDirection, "scaffolding", domain.AMCDOrient
	case 3:
		return domain.TeacherGuidanceConceptReminder, "retrieval_practice", domain.AMCDOrient
	case 4:
		return domain.TeacherGuidanceAnalogousExample, "demonstration", domain.AMCDRealize
	case 5:
		return domain.TeacherGuidancePseudocode, "scaffolding", domain.AMCDExecute
	case 6:
		return domain.TeacherGuidancePartialStructure, "guided_practice", domain.AMCDExecute
	default:
		return domain.TeacherGuidanceGuidedBreakdown, "guided_practice", domain.AMCDExecute
	}
}

func normalizeMethodIdentity(value string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

var _ PedagogyPlanner = PedagogyRegistry{}
var _ PedagogyMethod = ProgressiveHintMethod{}
